headline: Island Battles Flare at Lykos and Godcrofts Amid Mainline Shelling
war_summary: Since the previous edition, tactical movement has shifted back to the maritime sectors, where fresh clashes broke out across Godcrofts and Lykos Isle, yielding multiple base transitions and contested garrisons over the past two hours. Meanwhile, earlier coastal engagements across Farranac Coast have cooled into a temporary lull with no new base changes recorded. On the central mainland, Marban Hollow has witnessed a sharp acceleration in combat tempo, with combined casualty rates spiking above one thousand over the past two hours. Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse continue to absorb enormous attritional punishment, each logging over fourteen hundred casualties during the same interval despite slightly cooling rates in the central valley. Sustained artillery and skirmishing also press the lines in Stlican Shelf, Linn of Mercy, and Loch Mor, where defensive perimeters hold under steady pressure as both armies reinforce active fronts.
